question: The ratio of savings of two individuals is 6 : 5. If one increases his savings by 15% and the other by 10%, find their new savings ratio.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial savings ratio = 6 : 5

After increase ⇒ 6 × 115 : 5 × 110

⇒ 690 : 550

⇒ 69 : 55

**∴ The correct answer is 69 : 55 ratio.**
